observations.desc: Email with a credential-harvesting link addressed to a.rossi@contoso.example; the mail gateway quarantined it before delivery.
The linked page imitates the organization's sign-in page and posts what is typed to a host registered four days earlier.
Message trace for the sender and the link over the window: four copies, to four mailboxes, every one quarantined and none delivered.
No device and no account of the organization resolved or requested the link's host in the window; proxy and DNS logs cover every recipient.

observations.what: every copy of the message, in the gateway's quarantine

observations.shows: covered the rest of the activity and found nothing

reach.desc: Every copy of the message was held in the gateway's quarantine and nobody reached the page: nothing was delivered to a person.
